description: Defines the PastOrderList class for the Point of Sale feature in ERPNext, managing the display and filtering of past orders.

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.PastOrderList
classes.description: Class managing the past order list component in the POS interface.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the PastOrderList with wrapper and events.

methods.name: init_component
methods.description: Sets up the component by preparing DOM, creating filters, and binding events.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Creates the HTML structure for the past order list.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds event handlers for search input and invoice click actions.

methods.name: make_filter_section
methods.description: Creates search and status filter controls.

methods.name: refresh_list
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of past orders based on filters.

methods.name: get_invoice_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual invoice entries.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the component and refreshes the list if shown.
